messages:
sam: Quick update — I pushed the follow-up changes to the routing PR (fixes from yesterday's review). Removed the fallback race, tightened the timeout logic, and added a unit test that repros the kv-cache ordering. PTAL when you get a sec — hoping to merge before tomorrow's canary window.

nate: Thanks — I'll take a look in a bit. Do we need a changelog entry or is this internal?

sam: Internal only, but added a small comment in the PR description about the behaviour change. No public docs.

toni: Glanced at the test, looks reasonable. One nit: the timeout default is still 50ms in the config file; should we bump it to 75 for safer rollout?

sam: Good catch. I updated the config to 75ms and pushed one more commit (squashable).

ola: PTAL from me — the new test makes sense. Two requests: 1) can you add a short comment explaining why 75ms (so future folks don't revert it), 2) rebase to latest main to pick up the CI flake workaround.

sam: Yep — added the comment and rebased. CI is in progress.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/2201 — running tests for branch refs/heads/routing-fix (commit a3f4e1d)

ci-bot: buildkite/job/2201 — flaky-acceptance-suite failed on test 'kv_cache_rotation'; marking as flaky and re-running whole pipeline.

nate: If CI flakes again, please run only the acceptance suite job instead of the full pipeline to save cycles.

sam: Will do. If the re-run passes, can someone give a quick approval? I only need one more reviewer to satisfy the merge rule.

toni: I'll give a look and +1 if the re-run is green.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/2201 — pipeline passed (re-run).

toni: LGTM — minor nits but not blocking.
nate: Reviewed and approved. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks all — merging after the scheduled canary cutoff in ~30m unless anyone objects. If anything unexpected shows up in canary, I'll rollback and follow up. :rocket:

ola: No objections from me. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

sam: (merging)
